title: Verb 終わる
shortExplanation: Verbal action is completed; 'to finish', 'to end'.
longExplanation: The verb 終わる (owaru) is used to express that an action has been completed or something has come to an end. Despite ending in る, 終わる is a godan (u-verb), so it does not follow the typical ichidan (る-verb) conjugation. It is translated as 'to finish', 'to end' or 'to be over' in English.

examples.jp: 本を読み終わったら、返してください。
examples.en: When you finish reading the book, please give it back.

examples.jp: やっと宿題を書き終わりました。
examples.en: I finally finished writing my homework.

examples.jp: 晩ご飯を食べ終わってから、テレビを見ます。
examples.romaji: Bangohan o tabeowatte kara, terebi o mimasu.
examples.en: After I finish eating dinner, I watch TV.

examples.jp: その映画はもう見終わりましたか。
examples.romaji: Sono eiga wa mou miowarimashita ka.
examples.en: Have you finished watching that movie already?

usageNote: ます stem + 終わる: finish doing (読み終わる).

family.name: Start, Continue, Finish (Start To / Keep / Finish / Do To The End)
